About Cloza

CLOZA is a modern B2B marketplace designed to simplify wholesale purchasing and connect manufacturers, wholesalers, and retailers in one transparent and efficient platform.


Our mission is clear: to streamline and centralize B2B transactions, making it easier than ever for professionals to buy and sell in bulk with confidence and speed.

How to Order

Step 1

Find & Select Products

Browse the catalog to find profitable deals and add items to your cart.

Step 2

Review & Adjust

Check your cart, ensure supplier requirements are met, and adjust quantities if needed.

Step 3

Checkout & Payment

Verify details and complete your purchase with a credit card or bank transfer.

Step 4

Shipping & Support

Orders ship within 3 days. Have an order issue? Submit a claim and get a resolution within 24 hours.
